name: PLA+ (Tough PLA)
notes: High stiffness and easy printing, but low heat deflection (~55°C). Avoid near warm stepper motors.

name: PETG
notes: Good impact toughness and chemical resistance. Moderate stiffness; prone to creep under sustained load.

name: ABS / ASA
notes: High thermal resistance (~95°C) and low density. Requires enclosed chamber to prevent warping.

name: PETG-CF (Carbon Fiber)
notes: Carbon-fiber reinforced PETG: ~2x stiffer than standard PETG with low warp. Requires hardened nozzle.

name: PA12-CF (Nylon Carbon)
notes: Engineering-grade carbon-filled nylon. Exceptional stiffness-to-weight and 135°C HDT for high-torque robotics.

name: Aluminum 6061-T6 (CNC)
notes: Isotropic CNC-machined aerospace aluminum. High rigidity and zero layer anisotropy for heavy payloads.

name: Carbon Fiber Plate (3K CNC)
notes: Ultra-high in-plane stiffness and strength-to-weight ratio. Ideal for 2.5D plate profiles; avoid out-of-plane peel.

name: Aluminum 7075-T6 (Aero CNC)
notes: Aerospace-grade zinc-alloyed aluminum (503 MPa yield). Ideal for high-load WAM/Capstan and space-grade CNC structures.

name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V (Subsea/Aero)
notes: Corrosion-proof subsea ROV & aerospace titanium alloy (880 MPa yield, 114 GPa modulus).

name: Alloy Steel 4140 (Industrial CNC)
notes: Chromoly industrial alloy steel (655 MPa yield, 205 GPa modulus) for heavy 200 kg+ industrial robots like KUKA KR 210.

name: TPU 95A (Flexible / Pneumatic)
notes: Shore 95A flexible elastomer for soft pneumatic corrugated bellows (Festo BHA) and compliant grippers.
